# TikTok

> > TikTok is a global short-form video platform with offices spanning Los Angeles, Singapore, London, Tokyo, and other major cities, offering mobile apps for Android and iOS with built-in safety features and creator tools.

TikTok provides official resources for users, creators, and businesses including app downloads, safety guides, Effect House AR creation tools, and documentation addressing data security and corporate structure. The platform emphasizes community guidelines, parental controls, and transparent communication about its operations and U.S. data protection measures.

## Key Topics

- Community Guidelines
- Safety & Privacy
- Effect House (AR effects)
- Creator Economy
- U.S. Data Security
- TikTok Spotlight
- Guardian's Guide (parental controls)
- For You Feed algorithm
- ByteDance ownership
- Oracle partnership
- Android & iOS apps
- Video transitions & shooting
- Global offices (Los Angeles, Singapore, London, Tokyo, Berlin, Dubai)
- TikTok For Business

## Getting Started

- [About | TikTok](https://tiktok.com/about): TikTok company overview, mission, global offices, and community impact
- [Download the TikTok app for Android and iOS](https://tiktok.com/download/en): Official TikTok app download page for Android and iOS with QR code option
- [New user guide](https://tiktok.com/safety/en/new-user-guide): Beginner guide covering TikTok signup, privacy, and Community Guidelines

## Safety & Privacy

- [Guardian's Guide](https://tiktok.com/safety/en/guardians-guide): Parental guide for TikTok safety, teen controls, and For You feed overview
- [Facts Matter: How TikTok Protects U.S. User Data](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/facts-matter-how-tiktok-protects-us-user-data): U.S. data security measures via TikTok U.S. Data Security Inc. and Oracle
- [The Truth About TikTok: Separating Fact from Fiction](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/the-truth-about-tiktok): Fact-checking article on ByteDance ownership and TikTok corporate structure

## Creator Tools & Resources

- [Introduction to Effect House](https://effecthouse.tiktok.com/learn/guides/getting-started/introduction-to-effect-house): Getting started guide for Effect House AR effect creation platform
- [How To Film TikTok Transitions](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en-US/blog/behind-the-camera-shooting-tips-and-transitions-to-make-your-tiktoks): Video shooting tips and transitions tutorial for TikTok business creators
- [TikTok Spotlight](https://newsroom.tiktok.com/tiktok-spotlight): TikTok Spotlight launch for entertainment marketing and movie/TV promotion

## Help & Support

- [Helpful links](https://support.tiktok.com/en/help): TikTok support hub with links to account creation and profile setup help
- [Creating videos](https://support.tiktok.com/en/using-tiktok): TikTok help section for video creation, messaging, and audience growth
- [Log in](https://support.tiktok.com/en/log-in-troubleshoot): Login help and troubleshooting guide for TikTok account access issues
- [Contact | TikTok](https://tiktok.com/contact): TikTok contact page with Help Center, Partner Hub, and inquiry links
